SELECT 
  d.dept_name, 
  e.name, 
  e.salary 
FROM 
  Employees e 
JOIN 
  Departments d 
ON e.department_id = d.department_id 
WHERE e.salary = (
     SELECT 
        MAX(e2.salary)
     FROM Employees e2 
     WHERE e2.department_id = e.department_id
);
